tinker_eureka.name: Eureka!
tinker_eureka.description: Tinker gains %one_percent_tooltip%%% item cooldown reduction per %int_per_one_cdr% Intelligence, up to a maximum of %max_cdr%%%.

tinker_laser.name: Laser
tinker_laser.description: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.
tinker_laser.scepter_description: Upgrades Tinker's Laser into a Shrink Ray, reducing the main target's size, current health, and maximum health by %scepter_reduction_pct%%% (stacking). Does not pierce debuff immunity.
tinker_laser.lore: In his underground laboratory, Boush perfected this laser cutter for hard rock, never considering its use in combat.

tinker_march_of_the_machines.name: March of the Machines
tinker_march_of_the_machines.description: Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.
tinker_march_of_the_machines.scepter_description: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.
tinker_march_of_the_machines.facet_tinker_repair_bots: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.
tinker_march_of_the_machines.lore: Though the laboratory was sealed long ago, the radio call summoning robotic drones still functions.

tinker_deploy_turrets.name: Deploy Turrets
tinker_deploy_turrets.description: Deploys 3 uncontrollable turrets at the target location. Enemies hit by the impact take damage and are pushed away from the landing point. If Tinker is hit, he also gets pushed by the impact. Once deployed, the turret fires missiles in the direction of the nearest enemy hero.

tinker_rearm.name: Rearm
tinker_rearm.abilitydraft_note: For abilities with charges, a single charge of the ability will be added everytime Rearm is cast.
tinker_rearm.description: CHANNELED - Resets the cooldown on Tinker's abilities.
tinker_rearm.lore: A new battery here, a few rockets there — Boush is constantly refining and upgrading his devices.
